changeSet.author: snapdragon
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO games (id, name, description, slug, sort_order, created_at) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1 FROM games), 'Chess', 'Two-player chess. The host runs the full rules engine in their browser; the server only streams moves. Replay famous games or challenge a friend.', 'chess', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM games), NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM games WHERE slug = 'chess');

changeSet.author: snapdragon
changeSet.sql: -- The "levels" table was renamed to "chapters" in changeset 028; this seed -- (unlike the pre-rename 017 dodecahedron seed) targets the current name. INSERT INTO chapters (name, description, slug, scene_type, sort_order, asset_url, scene_config, game_id, created_at) SELECT 'Chessboard', 'Standard 8x8 chess. White and black join one session; the host engine is authoritative and the guest re-validates every move.', 'chess', 'chess', 1, '/api/assets/levels/chess/index.html', '{}', (SELECT id FROM games WHERE slug = 'chess'), NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chapters WHERE slug = 'chess');
